Hosted by comedy vet Royale Watkins, The Mixtape Comedy Show has been serving up the LIVEST comedy and music in New York City for more than a decade. The show is a non-stop night of laughs and entertainment, featuring a live band, a dj and a diverse mix of four hilarious comics from across the country. While the show doesn’t announce its' lineup, the show has featured some of the biggest names in stand-up with a few surprises from the world of hip-hop. From Jerry Seinfeld to Amy Schumer to Kevin Hart and Chris Rock. And on the music side, Doug E Fresh, Eric Sermon (EPMD) and Naughty by Nature have dropped in to energize the room and close the show on a music note. Not just a comedy show, It’s a night of entertainment you don’t want to miss!

Get ready to laugh until it hurts — for a cause that truly matters. The 19th Annual Laugh For Sight brings together some of the funniest comedians in the business for one unforgettable night of stand-up, all in support of the blindness community. This year, every dollar raised goes to two incredible organizations: InTandem, which gets blind and visually impaired New Yorkers out of the house and onto tandem bikes, promoting healthier, more active lifestyles one ride at a time, and The Seeing Eye, the legendary Morristown, NJ guide dog school that's been matching blind people with life-changing canine partners for nearly a century. Nineteen years in, Laugh For Sight remains proof that comedy can do more than make you laugh — it can change lives. Grab your tickets, grab your friends, and come be part of a night where every punchline packs a purpose.

fieldData.event-title: Lynne Koplitz (As Part of the NYCF)
fieldData.event-description:
As Part of 2026 The New York Comedy Festival!

Born in New York, but raised in Florida, Lynne Koplitz never lost her Long Island bite. After graduating from Troy University in 1992 with a degree in Theatre Arts and receiving a masters in Education Language Arts, Lynne began following her passion into comedy. Since that day, she has experienced a whirlwind of success on both stage and television. Lynne became the first woman since Roseanne Barr to sign a development deal with legendary producer Tom Werner at Warner Brothers. On television, Lynne was a regular on Joan and Melissa: Joan Knows Best. She also starred on the IFC cult favorite Z Rock. Lynne has been featured on The Late Late Show with Craig Ferguson, Tough Crowd with Colin Quinn, Comedy Knockout, and had her own special; Comedy Central Presents Lynne Koplitz. Koplitz can be heard co-hosting the radio show Star Talk with legendary astrophysicist Dr. Neil deGrasse Tyson and seen as a panelist on the History Channel’s History of the Joke hosted by Lewis Black. Lynne is also a featured comedian in Jenny McCarthy’s Epix comedy special “Dirty, Sexy, Funny," and her 2016 Netflix special "Hormonal Beast" is getting rave reviews! She is one of the most respected comedians in New York, and has recently opened for both Chris Rock and Louie CK

Our Family Rooms at NYC Health + Hospitals at Kings County and Elmhurst serve as the model for our growth. Located near the pediatric wings in both hospitals, The Ronald McDonald Family Rooms allow caregivers of children in treatment to prioritize what matters most: their child's health and well-being.
